explanation: The price rises 4 / 80 = 5%, so units fall 1.2 × 5% = 6%, to 1,880. Contribution goes from (80 - 60) × 2,000 = €40,000 to (84 - 60) × 1,880 = €45,120, a rise of 12.8%. Revenue falls slightly, from €160,000 to €157,920, which is why judging on revenue alone would wrongly reject the rise.
